audit_items.proof_trace: JWT authentication is correctly enforced for Engine API endpoints when configured properly. Two intentional bypass mechanisms exist (UnsecureDevNoRpcAuthentication config and per-URL 'no-auth' suffix), both documented as development-only features. Production deployments with default configuration enforce JWT validation at HTTP (Startup.cs:185-192) and WebSocket (JsonRpcWebSocketsModule.cs:64-67) entry points, rejecting unauthenticated callers.
